snippet.title: Wild n Chill - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3847920/Wild_n_Chill

Wild n Chill is a laid-back wilderness escape where ya forage, hunt, and craft the off-grid cabin of your dreams. Far from the noise and nonsense, it’s just you, your trusty companion, and a pal or two.

#indiegame #indiegames #steam #steamgames #craftingsurvival #survivalgame
